title: FUTURE PROPOSAL: /SHIFT, AN OUTER LOOP FOR AN 8-TO-5 FACTORY DAY
subtitle: Exploratory and not built (HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge#1081). One thin skill runs the day over the existing skills; the operator approves at three fixed points.

open.label: Morning open
open.caption: Reads /daily, the RELEASES rank, open PRs, CI and overnight /ate issues; runs a prior-art check to drop duplicates; checks the environment; proposes N budgeted items.

dispatch.label: Dispatch loop
dispatch.caption: Top approved item first. Stops at PR ready, never at merge.

stall.label: Stall check
stall.caption: Over budget or review cap: /unstuck or /sanity-check once, otherwise park with a reason.

merge.label: Merge windows
merge.caption: 12:00 and 16:00: land approved PRs, then refresh open PR branches.

close.label: Evening close
close.caption: Stops dispatch, checkpoints in-flight work, writes the end-of-day report.

operator.label: Human operator
operator.caption: Approves at three fixed points: the plan and two merge windows.

prerequisites.label: PREREQUISITES SEEN IN THE GH-55 SESSION
items: Structured skill results (PR URL, blocked, parked) instead of prose.
A morning environment check: Chromium and Codex fail inside the sandbox.
Branch refresh at each merge window: main moved under an open PR.
No new state store: the ledger and tick already hold day state.

entries.label: tick
entries.caption: Claims; the per-clone driver lock caps concurrency.

entries.label: End-of-day report
entries.caption: Shipped, PRs waiting, parked and why, tomorrow's queue.

legend.phase0: Phase 0 smallest bet: open and close only

footer.note: Future proposal, not built. No autonomous merge, deploy or clone teardown; no new daemon, queue or state store. Icons are hand-drawn vectors; no images were generated.
footer.source: Composed from exploratory issue HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge#1081 and the version 2 software factory diagram (examples/xyz-forge/today/software-factory-v2/).
